topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition of Backpropagation
target_audience: University students (STEM background) or tech-curious beginners

sections.title: The Analogy: How We Learn from Mistakes
lecture_lines: Learning is adjusting settings to reduce error.
Loss functions provide a score for our error.
Think of an archer adjusting their aim.
animations: Display an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/archer.svg] aiming a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bow.svg] at a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg]. [Color: #FFD700]
Show an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/arrow.svg] hitting above the bullseye of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg]. [Color: #FF4500]
Highlight the distance between [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/arrow.svg] and bullseye. [Label: 'Loss']

Repeat the shot with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/arrow.svg] successfully hitting the center of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/target.svg]. [Color: #32CD32]

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Computational Graph
lecture_lines: Neural networks are computational graphs of flow.
Nodes process data; edges represent weights.
Adjust weights to change the final output.
animations: Display a sequence of nodes [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg] and edges [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/edge.svg]. [Label: 'Network']
Trace forward flow of information through nodes [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg]. [Color: #8A2BE2]
Show changing one input value propagating changes through edges [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/edge.svg]. [Effect: Fade]

sections.title: The Gradient: The Direction of Correction
lecture_lines: The gradient is a compass for correction.
It senses sensitivity to weight changes.
We walk opposite the slope to descend.
animations: Show a topographic map representing Error. [Label: 'Loss Landscape'] [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg]
Place a point on the slope with a vector arrow. [Color: #FF6347]
Animate the point moving opposite to the gradient vector. [Effect: Smooth Movement]

sections.title: Backpropagation: The Credit Assignment Problem
lecture_lines: We traverse backward using the chain rule.
Each weight is updated by its contribution.
animations: Display output error [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg] node at the end. [Color: #FF4500]
Animate flow arrows moving backward through [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg] nodes. [Effect: Flow]
Update each [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg] node's weight based on backward flow. [Color: #FFD700]

sections.title: The Loop: Iterative Optimization
lecture_lines: The learning loop is a four-step cycle.
Forward pass, loss, backprop, then update.
animations: Represent the four steps in a circular layout surrounding the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg]. [Color: #FFFFFF]
Animate clockwise flow through the four steps. [Effect: Rotation]
Show weight adjustments converging over repetitions toward the center [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg]. [Color: #32CD32]
